## Avengers Vol 5 1

> There was nothing. Followed by [everything](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Earth-616 "Earth-616"). Swirling, burning specks of creation that circled around life-giving suns. And then...we raced to the light. It was the spark that the started **fire--**a **legend** that grew in **the telling.** Some believe it began the moment **[Hyperion](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Marcus_Milton_(Earth-13034) "Marcus Milton (Earth-13034)")** was rescued from [a dying universe](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Earth-13034 "Earth-13034"). Others say it was when **[The Guard](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Imperial_Guard_(Earth-616) "Imperial Guard (Earth-616)")** were broken on the dead moon. Many more think it was when **[Ex Nihilo](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Ex_Nihilo_(Earth-616) "Ex Nihilo (Earth-616)")** terraformed [Mars](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Mars_(Planet) "Mars (Planet)"), turning the red planet green. They are all **wrong.** As it happened before **[The Light](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/White_Event "White Event").** Before **[The War](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Infinity_(Event) "Infinity (Event)").** And before **[The Fall](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Time_Runs_Out "Time Runs Out").** It started with two men. It started with an idea.

—[Narrator](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Narrator "Narrator")

## Appearing in "The Avengers: Avengers World"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Avengers](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Avengers_(Earth-616) "Avengers (Earth-616)")

## Synopsis for "The Avengers: Avengers World"

A long time ago, there was nothing. Then there was everything. Many bits of creation swirled around the stars - planets that support life. And then one group of heroes raced into the light - the [Avengers](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Avengers_(Earth-616) "Avengers (Earth-616)").

On [Mars](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Mars_(Planet) "Mars (Planet)"), [Ex Nihilo](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Ex_Nihilo_(Earth-616) "Ex Nihilo (Earth-616)") begins to terraform Mars. He wants to make it have life. So he creates green plants on the red planet. And an intergalactic war is brewing because of him. At [Avengers Tower](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Stark_Tower_(Columbus_Circle,_Rebuilt) "Stark Tower (Columbus Circle, Rebuilt)"), [Tony Stark](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Anthony_Stark_(Earth-616) "Anthony Stark (Earth-616)") fumbles among some things regarding the Avengers and the [Illuminati](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Illuminati_(Earth-616) "Illuminati (Earth-616)"), remembering the day when it started with an idea - to create the Avengers. Later he walks down a hall with [Steve Rogers](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Steven_Rogers_(Earth-616) "Steven Rogers (Earth-616)"), and they talk about the day when Stark found Rogers in the ice. Stark says the world changed when Cap was found. He also says that the best ideas are the simplest ones. And that they now have a new idea: with problems escalating since [Cyclops](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Scott_Summers_(Earth-616) "Scott Summers (Earth-616)")' turn to the dark side, they need to grow bigger.
